project_type: Next.js 16 (App Router) web app — security-awareness / phishing-simulation training platform (PhishSafe)
build_system: Next.js 16 (next build). No bundler quirks. npm. Node 18+.
test_framework: NONE. No vitest/jest/cypress configured. Verification is lint + build only.
verification_instructions: After each feature: run `npm run lint` (must exit 0) then `npm run build` (must succeed, no TS/type errors). There is no unit-test runner. Do manual reasoning for runtime behavior (e.g. success page without session_id must not crash; launchCampaign with no orders must throw the allowance error and insert nothing). Clean up any scratch files before committing.
environment_constraints: The app CANNOT run DDL. Any new migration SQL must be reported to the user to run manually in the Supabase SQL editor. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY may be absent in the test env — all new code must degrade gracefully (treat as 'no verified orders', never crash). Do not edit .env. Do not restart long-running dev servers.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md. README.md documents setup. Keep the semantic-class CSS approach in src/app/globals.css (NO conversion to Tailwind utility classes). Never edit existing migration files — add new ones under supabase/migrations/.
key_patterns: Supabase server client via `import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'` (async, request-scoped, runs as the logged-in user under RLS). `orders` table has ONLY a SELECT RLS policy, so inserting/upserting orders requires a SERVICE-ROLE client (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) — check src/lib/supabase/ for an existing admin client before creating one. Server actions live in actions.ts files with 'use server'. Role check via `isAdmin(email, profile.role)` from '@/lib/authz'. Plans defined in src/lib/plans.ts (single=39 one-time, starter=49, growth=129, enterprise=299 monthly). Checkout route sends metadata[user_id]/metadata[plan]; DO NOT change its request shape. UI uses semantic CSS classes (.topbar, .role-pill, .page-heading, .eyebrow, .plan-card, .nav-link) defined in globals.css; dark mode via `.dark` prefix; responsive @media at 1050/760/540px.
directory_structure: src/app = App Router routes (dashboard/* authed pages, api/* route handlers, marketing pages at root/features/about/pricing, l/[slug] public landing pages, [campaignName]/.. tracking). src/components = shared UI (dashboard-shell, marketing-nav, resource-library, theme-toggle, submit-button, create-resource-dialog). src/lib = plans.ts, authz.ts, email.ts, ai.ts, supabase/ (server/client helpers). supabase/ = schema.sql + migrations/. globals.css = ALL styling (semantic classes).
orders_schema_fact: orders columns are ONLY: id, user_id, stripe_session_id (unique), plan (CHECK starter|growth|enterprise — MISSING 'single'), amount_cents, currency, status (CHECK pending|paid|cancelled|refunded), created_at. A NEW migration must widen the plan CHECK to include 'single' and add billing_type/period_start/credit_consumed columns.
entitlement_definition: usedThisMonth = count(campaigns where user_id=me AND created_at >= start of current UTC calendar month). Monthly quota: starter=2, growth=10, enterprise=Infinity. single = 1 consumable credit (oneTimeCredits = paid-single-orders minus credit_consumed=true singles). canCreate = remainingMonthly>0 OR oneTimeCredits>0. Consume monthly quota first, else mark one single order credit_consumed=true.
